subject: OnCall tooling: RFP/renewal coordination and evidence request
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@oncallpro.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OnCallPro renewal window + RFP support

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for the time last month. I’m reaching out because your account is coming up for renewal in ~45 days and we wanted to make this renewal as frictionless as possible. We can (a) proceed on the current contract with the standard renewal discount, or (b) run an RFP/expanded evaluation if you’re considering alternatives.

To make an RFP smooth we can provide: a one-page SLA summary, SOC 2 summary, a sandbox tenant for a 30-day tech eval, and a pricing worksheet that maps to your current seat/policy usage. I attached the pricing sheet to this message for initial visibility.

Quick asks so I can align the account team:
- Confirm the internal technical contact for the sandbox (cc'd Ethan?)
- Any specific security/compliance evidence you need beyond SOC 2?
- Target timeline for decision (are you aiming to finalize before end of August?)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week if helpful.

Best,
Claire Bennett
Enterprise Sales, OnCallPro
claire.bennett@oncallpro.com
Attachments: OnCallPro_pricing_sheet_Q3_2026.pdf (PDF, 72KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@oncallpro.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OnCallPro renewal window + RFP support

Thanks Claire — appreciate the proactive outreach.

Ethan will be our lead for the sandbox evaluation (confirmed). Laura in procurement and Monica from CS are looped for contract and usage details. A few priorities from our side:
- Security: SOC 2 is baseline; we sometimes need encrypted log-forwarding details, access control audit logs for the on-call console, and retention period for incident records. Can you include a short doc with those items?
- SLA: we need 99.95% uptime for the alerting API and a clear target MTTR for escalations. Please include recent uptime metrics for the API and incident delivery latency percentiles.
- Pricing: request a breakout that separates core seats, escalation SMS costs, and high-frequency webhook usage. Also include any tiered discounts at 12/24/36-month commits.
- Timeline: our internal decision target is second week of August (we need procurement cleared by 2026-08-12).

If you can provide the SOC 2 summary and API SLA doc by EOD Wednesday we’ll slot the sandbox access and start the tech eval on Thursday. I’ll also upload your pricing sheet to our shared Drive.

Marissa Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@oncallpro.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@oncallpro.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OnCallPro renewal window + RFP support

Marissa, Ethan — thanks, attached is the SOC 2 summary and a short SLA one-pager. I also attached an updated pricing worksheet that includes 12- and 24-month commit options and an enterprise support package (24/7 pager escalation path).

Highlights:
- SOC 2: controls mapped to our alert delivery pipeline and access management; last audit 2025 (no exceptions).
- SLA: 99.96% uptime for alerting API over the trailing 12 months; median delivery latency 180ms, 99th percentile 410ms (APAC is higher due to routing).
- Pricing: 10% standard renewal discount; 18% for a 24-month commit; add-on for SMS pass-through +0.003/message.

Attachments: OnCallPro_SOC2_summary_2025.docx (DOCX, 46KB), OnCallPro_pricing_sheet_Q3_2026.pdf (updated)

We can provision a sandbox for Ethan today — I’ll open access and send credentials if you confirm the test account list and IP allowlist.

— Claire
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: OnCallPro renewal window + RFP support

Looping back with a suggested evaluation plan so we can move fast:

1) Tech eval (Ethan) — 30-day sandbox, run replay of last 30 days of alerts, verify webhook throughput and deduping behavior.
2) Security review (Laura) — verify SOC 2 artifacts + encryption at rest/forwarding details.
3) Cost modeling (Finance) — map current usage to pricing options. Laura, can you confirm whether we should pursue the 24-month commit discount?
4) Competitive check — I recommend we invite two other vendors (PagerHill and StatusX) for a like-for-like RFP instead of auto-renewing. I’ll draft the RFP template and upload to the shared Drive.

Timeline I propose:
- 7/23: vendor SOC + pricing received (done)
- 7/24–7/30: tech sandbox tests + security signoff
- 8/2–8/6: exec summary and recommendation
- 8/12: procurement sign-off / PO issuance

Marissa — can you confirm the PO cutoff date and whether there’s any exec constraints on fast renewals (discount approvals, one-off credits)?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: OnCallPro renewal window + RFP support

Thanks team — plan looks good. A few procurement notes:

- PO cutoff for August processing is 2026-08-05 to guarantee vendor onboarding before the end of the month. If we miss that we'll have to push to the next cycle.
- We need the vendor to accept our standard data processing addendum; Claire, can you confirm OnCallPro will sign our DPA? If they require redlines, please flag now.
- For the competitive RFP, finance prefers we model both (a) 12-month extension with current seat count + SMS usage and (b) 24-month commit at projected growth + committed seat-top-up scheduling.

Monica — please upload your RFP_template_incident_tooling.xlsx to the shared Drive and include the evaluation matrix headers (security, reliability, cost, support). Ethan — once you have sandbox credentials, add test cases and any critical acceptance criteria.

I’ll aim to review recommendation materials on 8/3 and then present to Legal/Finance for final PO approval if everything is green.

Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
